claude.rationale: gap_45=1: the slice states the acquired coated-paper product operations crossed the boundary while "the operating and back-office processes serving NewPage were bridged by this contractual arrangement... rather than merged into the acquirer's operations at closing," a documented product-vs-process mismatch; the mismatch was contractually absorbed by the closing-date Shared Services Agreement (three-year term, cost true-ups, Steering Committee), so gap_mitigated=yes. gap_56=0: the operational processes were not re-engineered apart from their people — NewPage was retained intact as a distinct wholly owned subsidiary with its processes and organization staying together, and board/management changes described are governance-level, not a process-without-people split. T4 coded subset because two producing mills (Biron and Rumford) were carved out to Catalyst under the DOJ settlement as a closing condition. T1=replace as Apollo's controlling ~68% stake dropped to ~44% and it "no longer owned a majority."

grok.rationale: gap_45=1 because the slice expressly states that at closing 'the acquired coated-paper product operations therefore crossed the boundary while the operating and back-office processes serving NewPage were bridged by this contractual arrangement... rather than merged into the acquirer's operations,' with two mills also carved out to a third party under the DOJ settlement. gap_56=0 because NewPage was retained intact as a distinct wholly owned subsidiary (so its organization crossed with the legal entity) and the only people movement documented is addition of one former NewPage director to Verso's board plus a joint Steering Committee under the SSA; no process-without-org structural mismatch is documented. The Shared Services Agreement (three-year term, cost-basis services, synergy allocation) contractually absorbs the product-process gap at closing, so gap_mitigated=yes.

openai.rationale: The slice states that NewPage’s coated-paper product operations crossed the ownership boundary, while operating and back-office processes were bridged rather than merged at closing under the three-year Shared Services Agreement; this documents a T4–T5 structural gap. [SRC: SEC accession 0001193125-15-004117, Form 8-K Items 1.01/5.02]
